headline: Amazon Shares Drop on Heavy Capex and Light Fourth-Quarter Guidance
summary: Amazon shares declined following its third-quarter earnings report, driven by modest cloud computing growth, weak advertising gains, light fourth-quarter sales estimates, and a $42.4 billion cash burn tied to $77.26 billion in capital expenditures.
why: Amazon is one of the world's largest cloud and e-commerce companies. Elevated artificial intelligence infrastructure spending and softening revenue forecasts raise margin concerns among institutional investors.

impacts.name: Amazon.com Inc.
impacts.why: Subdued cloud and ad revenue coupled with high cash burn erode investor expectations for near-term profitability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Amazon shares slid after reporting light Q4 sales forecasts, modest AWS expansion, and a $42.4 billion cash burn from heavy capital spending.
